# ASUS G615LW-RV009W Belgian offer

Source: https://www.exellent.be/nl/pr/asus-rog-strix-g-g615lw-rv009w

Exellent lists this Belgian-AZERTY RTX 5080 SKU at €2549 with ASUS's extra warranty campaign. Exact fields show 275HX, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD and a matte 1920x1200 165Hz 300-nit 100% sRGB panel. Despite sharing the G615LW prefix, it is not the desired 2026 290HX Plus/P3 configuration and fails the factory-RAM and display gates.
